pros: Mostly flat half-marathon course through Thu Thiem and along the Saigon River
Generous four-hour half-marathon limit; the 2025 median finish was 2:23
Eight aid stations on the half, all with water and toilets
Closed lanes on the main roads, with no stoplights
Free race photos and results online by late morning
cons: Heavy humidity: 27°C and a 25°C dew point at the 2025 start
Unlit stretches in Thu Thiem, where a runner heard others trip in 2025
Few spectators outside the aid stations
Crowded last kilometre where the 10 km and half marathon merge
name: Garmin Run Vietnam 2026
short_description: Garmin Run Vietnam 2026 is on Sunday 18 October 2026 at Saigon Riverside Park in An Khanh ward, Ho Chi Minh City, over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon.
ai_summary: Garmin Run Vietnam 2026 is the Vietnam leg of the Garmin Run Marathon Series, held on Sunday 18 October 2026 with the expo on 17 October. The venue moved to Saigon Riverside Park (Cong vien Bo song Sai Gon) in An Khanh ward, about 2 km from the previous Sala site. Races are 21 km, 10 km and 5 km, plus 10 km and 5 km couple categories.

core_facts.venue: Saigon Riverside Park (Cong vien Bo song Sai Gon), An Khanh ward

faqs.question: What are the start times and cut-offs at Garmin Run Vietnam 2026?
faqs.answer: The half marathon starts at 4.00am with a four-hour limit, closing the course at 8.00am. The 10 km and couple 10 km start at 5.00am with 2 hours 30 minutes, and the 5 km and couple 5 km start at 5.30am with 90 minutes. The organisers say times may change.

faqs.question: How does the couple category work at Garmin Run Vietnam 2026?
faqs.answer: Couples register together and share one bib for the 5 km or 10 km. A team's result is the gun time of its second runner to finish. Runners must be at least 16 for the 21 km, 10 km and couple 10 km, and at least 12 for the 5 km and couple 5 km.
